answer.reason: Besides Tekoa being named as a home town, the verses tell of its fortification by Rehoboam and of its people's work on the wall of Jerusalem.

clauses.english: was built up by Rehoboam as one of his cities for defence
clauses.quote: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

clauses.english: sent its people to repair two pieces of the wall of Jerusalem
clauses.quote: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece,

doubts: 2SA 14:2 (Joab fetched a wise woman from Tekoah) left out as a minor event.
Verses naming Ira the Tekoite, Ashur father of Tekoa (a person), Jeremiah's call to blow the trumpet, and Amos's origin were left out as lists, a command or the summary's own content.
2CH 20:20 names the wilderness of Tekoa, not the settlement, so was left out.
